notes.title: 2021/5/20 the demo is waiting for you now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39373980/15c6ed90a0808082432463ef68f4d55888ca71a3.png[/img]
[h2]2021/5/20 the demo is released and waiting for you! [/h2]
[h3]Including 【Prologue】+【The first chapter- Opera House】, which is about 30~35% of the game.
Plz don't hesitate and give it a try! 
You can enjoy it for 1hr30m~2hr.
(Depended on how fast you read and solve the puzzles.)

If you like it,
don't forget to add it to your wish list and follow us! (*′д`)~♥[/h3]

[h3]EA will be accessible when Chapter 2 is completed. (50% done.)
I release EA because the game really needs you to get involved in the development and share your opinions to help make it better. 
I'll sincerely appreciate it.[/h3]

[h3]By the way, the emphasis of Chapter 1 is puzzle-solving, which is different from other chapters'. I believe the difference will bring you more surprise![/h3]

[h2]Notice:[/h2]
The demo and the EA are changeable. They may be different from the final released version.
Since the demo and the EA are changeable, your save point may get lost during the changes, please understand that before purchasing the game.
The full game includes four chapters. I’ll update the EA about 4~5 times to complete the game.

The first chapter- Opera House and Story 1 are ready!

I’m scheduled to upload the demo including Chapter 1 in late May.
EA will be accessible when Chapter 2 is done.
I release EA because the game really needs you to get involved in the development and share your opinions to help make it better. I sincerely appreciate it.

[h2]Notice:[/h2]
The demo and the EA are changeable. They may be different from the final released version.
Since the demo and the EA are changeable, your save point may get lost during the changes, please understand that before purchasing the game.
The full game includes four chapters. I’ll update the EA about 4~5 times to complete the game.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39373980/5c65fe2bd70f01d4fc815dcf646dd63b51e302f4.png[/img]
<1-5 S3>

[h1]Small talk[/h1]
Hi guys! It’s so good to see you! Blue Bird Land is my first work. I’ve been working on it for one year. It’s almost done by me alone, including the plot, the art and the programming. Though it’s only 35% done, the whole structure is nearly done now. I’m trying to complete it by August. You can follow the update on Patreon and Steam.

This year, I participated in many exhibitions and also released the closed beta to collect people’s opinions and advice. Now the game is much better! Thanks for helping me!

Making a game isn’t easy, but I got lots of happiness and a sense of achievement at the same time. I’ll keep going and do my best to complete BBL. Welcome to follow me and accompany me on my social media! (*´д`)~♥
